key: Uses Claude Code installed on this Mac and your Claude subscription login; requests count against its usage limits. Run `claude` once in Terminal to log in. Model: an alias (sonnet, opus) or a full id. Effort: low, medium, high, xhigh, or max (none and minimal become low).

comment: Settings > AI caption. Keep commands in backticks, model aliases, effort values (low, medium, high, xhigh, max, none, minimal, auto), and product names untranslated.
translation: Verwendet das auf diesem Mac installierte Claude Code und die Anmeldung mit dem Claude-Abonnement; Anfragen zählen zu dessen Nutzungslimits. Zum Anmelden einmal `claude` im Terminal ausführen. Modell: ein Alias (sonnet, opus) oder eine vollständige ID. Aufwand: low, medium, high, xhigh oder max (none und minimal werden zu low).

key: Uses Codex installed on this Mac and your ChatGPT login; requests count against your plan's usage limits. Run `codex login` once in Terminal to log in. Effort: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, or max. An empty model uses Codex's default.
english: Uses Codex installed on this Mac and your ChatGPT login; requests count against your plan's usage limits. Run `codex login` once in Terminal to log in. Effort: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, or max. An empty model uses Codex's default.
comment: Settings > AI caption. Keep commands in backticks, model aliases, effort values (low, medium, high, xhigh, max, none, minimal, auto), and product names untranslated.
translation: Verwendet das auf diesem Mac installierte Codex und die ChatGPT-Anmeldung; Anfragen zählen zu den Nutzungslimits des Tarifs. Zum Anmelden einmal `codex login` im Terminal ausführen. Aufwand: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh oder max. Ohne Modell wird der Standard von Codex verwendet.

key: Uses the Antigravity CLI installed on this Mac and the Google account it is logged in with; requests count against that account's limits. Run `agy` once in Terminal to log in; `agy models` lists the model ids. Effort: low, medium, high, or max, only for a model id without its own level (a model ending in -high, -medium, or -low ignores it). Runs use agy's hearsay-notes project, whose deny rules leave the model no tools except web search, and each run's conversation is deleted from agy's history afterwards.
english: Uses the Antigravity CLI installed on this Mac and the Google account it is logged in with; requests count against that account's limits. Run `agy` once in Terminal to log in; `agy models` lists the model ids. Effort: low, medium, high, or max, only for a model id without its own level (a model ending in -high, -medium, or -low ignores it). Runs use agy's hearsay-notes project, whose deny rules leave the model no tools except web search, and each run's conversation is deleted from agy's history afterwards.
comment: Settings > AI caption. Keep commands in backticks, model aliases, effort values (low, medium, high, xhigh, max, none, minimal, auto), and product names untranslated.
translation: Verwendet die auf diesem Mac installierte Antigravity CLI und das Google-Konto, mit dem sie angemeldet ist; Anfragen zählen zu den Limits dieses Kontos. Zum Anmelden einmal `agy` im Terminal ausführen; `agy models` listet die Modell-IDs auf. Aufwand: low, medium, high oder max, nur für eine Modell-ID ohne eigene Stufe (ein Modell, das auf -high, -medium oder -low endet, ignoriert ihn). Läufe verwenden das agy-Projekt hearsay-notes, dessen Deny-Regeln dem Modell außer der Websuche keine Werkzeuge lassen, und die Konversation jedes Laufs wird danach aus dem agy-Verlauf gelöscht.

key: Uses the Copilot CLI installed on this Mac and its own login. Run `copilot` once in Terminal to log in. "auto" lets Copilot pick the model.
english: Uses the Copilot CLI installed on this Mac and its own login. Run `copilot` once in Terminal to log in. "auto" lets Copilot pick the model.
comment: Settings > AI caption. Keep commands in backticks, model aliases, effort values (low, medium, high, xhigh, max, none, minimal, auto), and product names untranslated.
translation: Verwendet die auf diesem Mac installierte Copilot CLI und deren eigene Anmeldung. Zum Anmelden einmal `copilot` im Terminal ausführen. Mit „auto“ wählt Copilot das Modell.
